dialogues.speaker: Naiyan
dialogues.text: You'd better get well soon, Milray. There are still so many things I want to say to you.

dialogues.speaker: Milray
dialogues.text: Naiyan, Antu... Once I'm all better, let's go have some fun together again.

dialogues.speaker: Naiyan
dialogues.text: You'd better get better soon!

dialogues.speaker: Antu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Milray... I've already found a way to cure you.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright... Grab the gloves, and don't forget the board.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Today's lucky color is... Powder blue, I think? Shame we can't go ask Citlali right now...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, and I still need to put up a sign at the shop...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "The shopkeeper will be out momentarily. Please take what you need and leave your payment in the bag nearby..."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "If you're short on money right now, then just take what you need..."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "Have a great time while I'm away, everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hmm, is that... giving off the wrong vibe?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: "Let's all enjoy ourselves and have loads of fun together!"

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: There. Much better. Alright then, time for me to head out!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Relax, bro, relax. It's just a scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: This isn't a real battle. Just a drill, yeah? Your buddy is a-okay. Totally safe.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You can jump right back in once you've recovered. Just kick back and chill for now, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I'll get your buddy to swing by in a sec. Don't go too hard, or your wound won't heal right.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: That's right, you're doing just fine, kiddo. Go catch a few Z's.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch, I got sawdust in my eyes! Coach Iansan, help...!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Open your eyes. Let me see if I can get it out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sobbing*... I can't open them, and I can't stop the tears...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That's why I told you to wear protective goggles...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Just lie down, I'll go get some water to wash it out.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: "War Rages Through Natlan: Which of the Six Tribes Will Prevail?"

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: As long as I can just get this article written out, the headlines for next week, even the week after... They'll be in the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: All that time, all that effort, coming all the way from Fontaine... It'll all be worth it! I only brought a single Kamera, but that should be enough...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Let me think... I still need to go interview some other contestants... Oh yeah, they're even saying the Pyro Archon herself will be appearing, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: If I can get a picture of her... Hehe, won't that be a massive scoop?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hehe, hehehe, hehehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Feeling hungry? I just picked these from the orchard.

dialogues.speaker: Naiyan
dialogues.text: Raaaawr...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Go on, have some. Taking care of a patient like you're doing is hard work. Don't wear yourself out with worry, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Naiyan
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If you need more, there's plenty more where that came from!

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: The Bloomflower Trials are in full swing! Which tribe would you two like to join?

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: You want me to go over the rules? Sure.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: The Bloomflower Trials are divided into "Offensive Battles" and "Defensive Battles."

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Defensive battles are simple, just stop your opponents from attacking the tribe. Playing offense is trickier. Assuming your tribe's lost its defense, they have to sound a horn and counterattack.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: To spice things up, we've added special ritual items into the mix. Attackers can charge them up to destroy the defenders' special barriers.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: And even if this is a competition, we don't want to see uncalled-for violence or conflicts. Anything broken should be fixed, and if you see monsters, please clear them out.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Hoo boy, this competition's got quite the turnout. I'm sure you two see some familiar faces among the contestants.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: My friend's also heading to the competition venue. Once I've wrapped things up here, I'm going to go cheer him on.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Haha, I hope all our participants can go all-out in this competition! Go forth, and battle to your heart's content!

dialogues.speaker: Vinesh
dialogues.text: Welcome to the "Saurian Expedition Supply Station." We're currently guiding the little saurians along on their expedition. Want to join in?

response.speaker: Vinesh
response.text: My brother and I are interns at Mr. Ifa's clinic. Although we've only been working there for a short time, every day is fulfilling.

response.speaker: Vinesh
response.text: Mr. Ifa and Mr. Cacucu are both amazing. My brother and I would love to become vets beloved by saurians, just like them.

response.speaker: Vinesh
response.text: I especially admire Mr. Cacucu, hehe. Although... he's been picking a concerning number of fights with another weird, yellowish little saurian lately.

response.speaker: Vinesh
response.text: That little thing calls itself "Almighty Dragonlord," or something like that. I hope he doesn't become a bad influence on Mr. Cacucu...
